authority: ADR 0025 decision 2 / DOCTRINE_ENFORCEMENT.md §3 — a census that reports is not a check. `check_production_genericity_flow.sh` already derives all eighteen counts on every commit; this is the declaration it compares them against, so a drift is caught at commit cadence instead of at push cadence by a cargo test.

boundary.rationale: These describe the genericity boundary itself — which types are sources, which roots are rules, which regions are trusted. Ordinary feature work does not move them: measured unchanged across the six consecutive slices that each moved the volume counts below. A change here is a real change to the product's authority structure and must fail closed. Moved once, deliberately, by EXTRACTION-QUALITY-GAUGE.3k.6: two non_authoritative_root rows (diagnostic.constraint_replay, diagnostic.constraint_replay_gates) register the read-only constraint replay, which reads raw evidence to report what the current producer still mints and writes nothing. Registering it as diagnostics_only rather than as a grammar root is the point — it has no authority over any artifact, and the boundary should say so. Moved a SECOND time, for the same reason and by the same shape, by SIGNAL-DECLARATION-ROW-DROP.4e: one non_authoritative_root row (diagnostic.declaration_replay) registers the read-only declaration replay, which reads raw evidence to report what the current SemanticIR declaration reader does with a persisted artifact's own statements and writes nothing. That the boundary had to be edited at all is the control working: a function that reads raw evidence and reaches semantic control cannot land silently, and declaring it diagnostics_only is the statement that it has authority over no artifact. Moved by EXTRACTION-REPRESENTATION-GAPS.24.b: two rule roots (semantic.rs#document_signal_coreference_records, #document_signal_family_records) register the producers of semantic.statement_lift's two new fields, signal_coreferences and signal_families; each is a registered derivation with proof claims, so its producer is a rule root, not unrooted code. Moved again by EXTRACTION-REPRESENTATION-GAPS.10.g.ii: one rule root (semantic.rs#document_operation_kind_records) registers the producer of semantic.statement_lift's operation_kinds field, by the same reasoning. Moved again by EXTRACTION-REPRESENTATION-GAPS.3.b.iii.g: one producer entrypoint (evidence.rs#protocol_transition_surface) registers the producer of evidence.protocol_structure's new field protocol_transitions; the family is grammar_introduces, so the one registration is both a rule root and a grammar root, and rule_roots and grammar_declassifiers each move by one. Moved again by EXTRACTION-REPRESENTATION-GAPS.3.d.ii.a.i: one producer entrypoint (evidence.rs#check_signal_surface) registers the producer of evidence.declaration's new field check_signal_records; the family is grammar_introduces, so the one registration is both a rule root and a grammar root, and rule_roots and grammar_declassifiers each move by one. aggregate_change.rationale: EXTRACTION-REPRESENTATION-GAPS.64: a matrix cell's or data-column title's trailing mark cites the one note printed beside the matrix (trailing_note_marks, bind_matrix_notes).

volume.rationale: These are sizes, not boundaries: they move whenever production code is added, which is every ordinary slice. Six consecutive slices moved them and each had to edit a literal to land. Declaring them as baseline + delta with an owner converts that edit from re-pinning a number nothing compares into attributing a census change to the leaf that caused it — the same `aggregate_change` idiom `doctrine/live_document_size/surfaces.jsonl` already uses for the book's byte total.
